desc: This slip of paper, inscribed with the Seal of single combat, can be torn (destroying it) by the Wielder to Seal themself and a Target they see into a ritual trial. Once Sealed, both are forced to Co…

stat.effects: This slip of paper, inscribed with the Seal of single combat, can be torn (destroying it) by the Wielder to Seal themself and a Target they see into a ritual trial. Once Sealed, both are forced to Coin-flip each time they would attempt to flee or take hostile Action against another Creature than their partner in the ritual. The ritual ends if either surrenders, is Incapacitated, or dies.

This Consusumes the Talisman.

You are surrounded by a cascade of black flower petals, conferring Soft Cover for 1 Minute. For the Duration, your Strikes with the Knife deal more Damage by your Tier. Using this Technique more than once in a single Hour Notches the Enchantment.

name: True-Bite
desc: The Enchanted Knife ignores Soft Cover completely.

stat.effects: The Enchanted Knife ignores Soft Cover completely.

stat.effects:
The Enchanted Cleaver grants its Wielder the engraved Technique:

While Frenzied, you are unable to Resist Attacks with your Skills, but you can reduce any Damage you suffer for the Duration by 3 as a 0_AP Reaction which Notchtes the Enchantment.

When a Creature falls Prone or takes Falling Damage within 10 Meters, you instantly teleport to their Engagement and make a 1_AP Strike against them, Stunning them for Rounds up to your Tier on a hit.

stat.effects:
